'''Quetemoor the Elder''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mugaari]] who was one of the co-leaders of a Mugaari criminal family that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Quetemoor shared power with her younger brother [[Quetemoor the Sub-Elder]] and her relatives [[Quetemoor the Venerable]] and [[Quetemoor the Younger]].<ref name="CCW" />
